Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, make me in it (this day/month) among those who seek forgiveness

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ القَانِتِينَ
Translation: And make me in it among Your righteous and devout servants
And make me in it among Your close friends
By Your kindness, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
